nodes.name: Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Builds the Python 3.12 backend image, installs the application and curl, provisions persistent-data storage, exposes port 8000, and starts the FastAPI app with Uvicorn.

nodes.summary: Defines the Python runtime service that hosts Assumption Zero through Uvicorn on port 8000 with its data directory under /app.
